newsitem.title: UK: TV says 96 hurt in Casablanca fire.
newsitem.headline: TV says 96 hurt in Casablanca fire.

text.p: A fire broke out in a Casablanca shanty town on Sunday night, injuring 96 people, Moroccan television reported on Monday.
The television, monitored by the British Broadcasting Corporation, quoted an interior ministry communique as saying the fire destroyed 118 tin shacks and took three hours to bring under control.
It said the cause of the fire, in the Belmsik district, was unknown. The government had given emergency aid to those affected, it added.
